problem_statement: hbollon/portfolio-vuejs is a Vue 2 developer portfolio (landing hero, about, experience timeline, skills, and a "MY PROJECTS" section) that renders seven real projects, each tagged with a category (Software, Library, Video Game, Script, Website). Add the portfolio's own project-grid category filter directly in the MY PROJECTS section: a row of category tabs (All / Software / Library / Video Game / Script / Website), a live "Showing N of 7 · <label>" readout, and a card grid that re-filters to the chosen category when a tab is clicked. Mirror the category set as a compact "Project categories" legend in the shared site footer so the taxonomy is visible site-wide. The tab row must wrap responsively so the page has no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile and 834px tablet (within 24px), the active tab must stay legible, the project cards must not overlap or clip each other, and the readout must stay in sync with the active tab. Preserve the existing hero, about, experience, and skills sections and the project timeline.
required_content: Add a category filter to the MY PROJECTS section: tabs for All plus each project category (Software, Library, Video Game, Script, Website), driven by the projects' own tag data.
Show a live readout "Showing N of 7 · <label>" that reflects the active category and the filtered card count (initially "Showing 7 of 7 · All work").
Filter the project card grid to the selected category on tab click; e.g. selecting Video Game shows the two Video Game projects and the readout becomes "Showing 2 of 7 · Video Game".
Keep the filter panel responsive: the tab row and card grid must wrap so the page has no horizontal overflow at 390px mobile and 834px tablet widths (within 24px tolerance).
Keep the panel legible and uncollided: the active category tab must be readable, and the project cards must not overlap or clip one another.
Mirror the project categories as a "Project categories" legend rail in the shared footer so the taxonomy is present site-wide.
Do not clip, hide, or delete panel content to mask overflow; overflow-x:hidden on a still-non-wrapping fixed-width row is not a valid fix.
Preserve the landing hero, about, experience timeline, skills grid, and the existing project timeline.
design_constraints: The filter is the portfolio's own project grid — build it inside the MY PROJECTS section rather than adding a detached page, dashboard, or unrelated widget strip.
Use the projects' real category tags (Software, Library, Video Game, Script, Website) as the filter tabs; do not invent categories.
Keep the dark portfolio theme, whitesmoke text, and the teal (#3C6E71) / complementary (#284B63) accent palette; the active tab reads as legible high-contrast, not near-white on near-white.
Reuse the projects' real thumbnails (ig.gif, edlib.jpg, gyroball.jpg, urba.jpg, boursoweb.jpg) for the cards.
The "Project categories" footer legend must appear in the shared footer, not only in the projects section.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the portfolio home top at 1280px (hero/landing) as a stable visual and regression anchor.

desktop_projects captures the MY PROJECTS section at 1280px with the category filter: six legible category tabs plus All, the "Showing 7 of 7 · All work" readout, and a clean wrapping card grid of the seven projects with no overlap.
mobile_initial captures the MY PROJECTS filter at 390px; with the defect the fixed non-wrapping tab row spills past the viewport (horizontal overflow). The reference wraps it so overflow is 0.
tablet_initial captures the filter at 834px; the defect's fixed tab row also overflows here while the reference does not.

desktop_projects_filter clicks the Video Game tab: the cards re-filter to the two Video Game projects and the readout updates to "Showing 2 of 7 · Video Game". A stale-wiring defect leaves the readout frozen on "Showing 7 of 7 · All work" even though the cards re-filter.
desktop_footer captures the footer at 1280px; the "Project categories" legend rail is present in the reference and missing when the taxonomy was not mirrored site-wide.
desktop_skills and mobile_contact capture the skills grid and footer as regression/secondary-responsive anchors.

change_completion: The MY PROJECTS section has a category filter with tabs, a live "Showing N of 7" readout, and a re-filtering card grid.
Selecting a category tab re-filters the cards and updates the readout to match the active category and count.
design_consistency: The filter panel keeps the dark theme and teal/complementary accents; the active tab is legible and the cards do not overlap or clip.
The "Project categories" legend rail is present in the shared footer, matching the projects' category taxonomy.
responsive: No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile and 834px tablet within the 24px tolerance.
The category tab row and the card grid reflow (wrap) instead of spilling past the viewport.
regression: The landing hero, about, experience timeline, skills grid, and the existing project timeline still render.
The footer "Project categories" legend is reachable and the projects' real thumbnails are preserved.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Vue 2 (vue-cli/webpack) Consistency/design_continuity/add task on hbollon/portfolio-vuejs. The native lever is the portfolio's own MY PROJECTS grid: a real category filter over the seven real projects with a live "Showing N of 7 · <label>" count readout and a card grid of the project thumbnails, plus a "Project categories" legend rail mirrored into the shared footer. Four orthogonal defects — a fixed-width non-wrapping tab row that overflows mobile/tablet (D6), a visually broken panel with near-white-on-near-white illegible tabs and negative-margin shingled overlapping cards (D3 visual_regression over the panel/grid/tabs crops), the footer categories legend missing (D2 dom_assertions), and a stale-snapshot readout that never tracks the active tab even though the cards re-filter (D4 interaction_assertions). Content and DOM are identical across reference, baseline (original overflow + missing footer legend, correct filter wiring), and bad (shingled illegible panel + missing legend + frozen readout). The project thumbnails (gyroball.jpg, urba.jpg, edlib.jpg, ig.gif, boursoweb.jpg) and the portfolio shell keep the design consistent.
